item.description:
The terms changed with this version (2026-08-21).

Your Kit will now tell us which of its own health checks is unhappy, the one line it says about itself, and the fix it suggests.

Why: Three beta Kits sat unwell for weeks. Each one told us something was wrong and never what, so the only way to help was to email its owner and ask them to go digging. Now it can say "the nightly dream cycle has not finished since Tuesday" instead of "5".

What it never includes: Only Kit talking about its own machinery: counts, timings, states, and the names of its own parts. Never your memories, messages, files, or anything you or your Kit work on.

If you would rather not: Nothing changes for you. Your Kit keeps updating and keeps every fix; it just carries on reporting exactly what it does today. Your Kit will ask you once, inside the app, after it updates.

  • The button for uploading a chat archive now works. In 0.2.202 it did nothing at all inside the app: a file chooser needs the app to answer a request the window never answered, so the click was accepted and no panel ever opened. It worked in a browser, which is where it was tested, and that is why it went out broken. Every file chooser in the app is wired now, not just this one.
  • The web chats section says the true thing about itself. Your kit has no direct access to ChatGPT or Claude, so the export has to be requested from them: each row now links to that provider's own instructions, and the link opens in your browser rather than inside your kit.
  • One number for how many memories you have. The wake card was counting Kit's own plumbing (handoffs, plans, run exhaust) and Fireflies was not, so the same kit reported 41,823 in one place and 30,630 in another. The headline is now the memories that have value to you, and the plumbing stays Kit's business. Nothing was deleted and nothing changed about what your kit can recall.
